text:
Nothing documented happened to Paul McCartney on November 9, 1966. That date comes from the "Paul is dead" hoax, which claimed he died in a car crash and was replaced, and he was alive and performing with the Beatles afterward, so the "He died" option in the team note is false. I'm not certain of the exact dates of his minor moped accident, which some sources place in December 1965, so I can't rule out an unrelated minor incident that week.

CONFIDENCE: 80
